aliases.policy: Every API ID collected separately; fixture group is an annotation only

source_snapshot.read_mode: uri mode=ro; PRAGMA query_only=ON; BEGIN; ROLLBACK; close

schema.matches: CREATE TABLE matches ("match_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',"cmp_type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',"competition_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',"competition_name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',"team_A_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',"team_A_name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',"team_B_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',"team_B_name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',"kickoff_utc" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',"kickoff_local" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',"status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',"minute" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',"score_home" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',"score_away" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',"fetched_at_utc" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "period" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "score_note" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "team_A_logo" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "team_B_logo" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', PRIMARY KEY (match_id))
schema.odds_history: CREATE TABLE odds_history (dedupe_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,"match_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',"cmp_type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',"competition_name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',"home_team" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',"away_team" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',"kickoff_utc" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',"kickoff_local" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',"company_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',"company_name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',"company_abbr" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',"market_type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',"source_time" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',"change_time_local" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',"home_water" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',"handicap_text" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',"handicap_value" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',"away_water" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',"score" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',"fetched_at_utc" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',"source_url" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '')
schema.odds_minute_order:
CREATE TABLE odds_minute_order (
        match_id TEXT NOT NULL, company_id TEXT NOT NULL, market_type TEXT NOT NULL,
        change_time_local TEXT NOT NULL, sequence_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
        sequence_json TEXT NOT NULL, source_url TEXT NOT NULL, fetched_at_utc TEXT NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY(match_id,company_id,market_type,change_time_local,sequence_hash))
schema.similarity_revision_clock: CREATE TABLE similarity_revision_clock(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1), epoch TEXT NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL)
schema.similarity_source_versions: CREATE TABLE similarity_source_versions(mid TEXT NOT NULL,channel TEXT NOT NULL,revision INTEGER NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(mid,channel))
schema.match_score_aliases:
CREATE TABLE match_score_aliases(
        alias_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, source_id TEXT NOT NULL, identity_json TEXT NOT NULL,
        first_verified_utc TEXT NOT NULL, last_verified_utc TEXT NOT NULL,
        original_json TEXT NOT NULL, source_json TEXT NOT NULL, basis TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'exact-sport-league-team-ids-kickoff',
        CHECK(alias_id<>source_id))
schema.odds_collection_state:
CREATE TABLE odds_collection_state (
        match_id TEXT NOT NULL, company_id TEXT NOT NULL, market_type TEXT NOT NULL,
        status TEXT NOT NULL, last_attempt REAL NOT NULL, last_finished REAL,
        last_success REAL, next_retry REAL NOT NULL, failures INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        error_type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', error TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        history_rows INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        PRIMARY KEY(match_id, company_id, market_type))

limitations: Played means source status, not independently verified 90-minute result.
Past kickoff with blank status is a collection candidate, never a verified final label.
Historical exports do not override the current live-source fixture snapshot.
Old dongqiu.org site IDs absent from the DQD source are quarantined rather than inferred.
Historical market collection does not establish that these observations were available before kickoff.
